api.name: <provider display name, e.g. PayPal>
api.id: <lowercase id used in skill and file names, e.g. paypal>
sdk.repoUrl: <https URL of the SDK source repo>
sdk.cloneRef: <the pinned ref the map was generated from — a tag or full commit SHA; a branch is not a pin>
sdk.envLogVar: <the SDK's log env var: UPPER(rootNamespace) + CLIENT_LOG, e.g. PAYPALSERVERSDKCLIENT_LOG>
map.pathInSdkRepo: <directory inside the SDK repo holding sdk-map.md and map/ - the SDK root, i.e. the directory with the .csproj; '.' when the SDK is the repo root>
